label: Typical learner checks (deliberately weak)
origin: Hand-authored for Countertrace to imitate common directed-testbench checks. Explicitly weak for demonstration; not a user's testbench.
description: Drives one directed sequence (fill exactly, drain exactly, wrap once) and checks flags after reset, writes, and reads, plus data order on plain reads. It never requests a write while full, a read while empty, simultaneous operations, or a second reset.

checks.text: After a write, empty is low.
After the last free slot is written, full is high.
A read returns the oldest word.
After the last word is read, empty is high.
